notes:
- **The Workshop - the MyCraftingAI community**: a new **The Workshop** page in the sidebar. Browse spaces like Showcase, Mod Releases, Help & Bugs, Textures & Models and Tutorials, sort by Hot, New, Top or Active, and search every post.
- **Share your mods from the app**: press **New post**, then **Add from project** to attach your mod's .jar, a project ZIP, textures, models (.bbmodel), sounds or logs straight from the open project. Images show right in the post.
- **Comments, votes and follows**: reply in threads, up- and downvote, save posts for later and follow a post to get a notification for every new comment.
- **Private messages**: chat 1:1 with other modders and send images or files. You can block anyone or turn messages off.
- **Notifications**: replies, mentions, messages and moderator notes - with an unread badge on the sidebar.
- **Safe downloads**: shared files are checked by type on the server and downloaded only after you confirm. Each file shows its SHA-256 fingerprint. Report anything harmful with one click.
- The same community is on the website at mycraftingai.com/community.html. Please read the new [community rules](https://mycraftingai.com/community-rules.html).
